note: THE required-evidence contract (#1232, #1362): given changed files, `yarn verify:impact` prints exactly what evidence is required before the change is complete, and this file is where that is decided. CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and .claude/rules explain WHY evidence exists; they must not define a second required-gate matrix (scripts/check-agent-policy-parity.mjs, rule `required-gates-defer-to-impact`, fails a prose requirement for a gated command that this file does not own). `evidence` is the ordered catalog; a rule's `require` refers to evidence ids; `baseline` always applies (pre-push obligations). `diagnostics` are optional, never required, never a merge gate: a rule may `suggest` one, and `verify:impact` lists it separately from required evidence. Every rule/evidence/diagnostic cites the policy surface that explains it in `why`/`source`, and that surface must still contain the cited heading. Durable evidence stays reusable: its commands pair a runner with its `:status` readback, so a proof for the same HEAD is read, not re-run.

evidence.why: AGENTS.md → Required Verification: after editing files under src/, run the source-rule check.
AGENTS.md → Test-selection rule: run the mirrored tests/ file for each changed src/ file.

.claude/rules/ai-simulation.md governs src/ai/**; the focused AI behavior regression is tests/simulation/ai-playability.test.ts. #1132: the canonical command is durable; read its result back through :status.
.claude/rules/performance-budgets.md → run before finishing a change to turn orchestration, a full AI round, pathfinding, the movement-cost model, visibility, or save serialize/parse/normalize.
AGENTS.md → for legendary wonder, quest-race, or wonder-panel changes, run the wonder regressions.
AGENTS.md → when touching src/platform/**, src-tauri/**, Vite distribution config, service worker registration, or save import/export, run the Tauri frontend build.
AGENTS.md → CI-shard rule: adding, removing, or renaming a default-discovered Vitest test requires refreshing scripts/ci-test-shards.json.
CLAUDE.md → Documentation Authority (#1024) and .claude/rules/spec-fidelity.md: docs/superpowers/{plans,specs} are classified in docs/docs-lifecycle-manifest.json.
AGENTS.md → after editing .claude/hooks/**, .claude/settings.json, or tests/hooks/**, run the hook suite.
.claude/rules/audio-sfx.md (#612): unit SFX assets are capability-derived and validated against docs/audio/unit-sfx-manifest.md.

.claude/rules/ai-simulation.md: the long-horizon campaign suite is explicit-run only; run it after changing the suite itself. #1132: the canonical command is durable; read its result back through :status.
CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md → Required Verification: run yarn build before any push, PR, or merge.
CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md → before git push, PR creation, or merge, run the durable full suite and confirm its status.

diagnostics.when: Optional campaign-level evidence after a substantial change to AI strategic planning, production, diplomacy, movement, combat decisions or the economy. It is NOT required for those changes (only the evidence above is) and is not a merge gate; the long-horizon runtime target is a separate, independently owned workstream (#1125).

.claude/rules/ai-simulation.md: the long-horizon campaign suite is explicit-run only; run it after changing the suite or its wrapper.
AGENTS.md → legendary wonder, quest-race, or wonder-panel changes.
